{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Confirm the column exists and check for missing values
print("Column 'body_mass_g' dtype:", penguins['body_mass_g'].dtype)
print("Missing values in 'body_mass_g':", penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum())

# Drop rows with missing body_mass_g and compute mean
mean_body_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].dropna().mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean body mass (grams): {mean_body_mass}")"}
